title: Voyager 1 one-way radio signal delay
notes: Voyager 1 launched in 1977. Its 1990 'Pale Blue Dot' images were taken from about 40 AU out (light-time ~5.5 hours). It crossed the heliopause into interstellar space at about 121 AU in 2012 (light-time ~16.8 hours). By 2024 it was roughly 170 AU out, with a reported one-way signal delay of about 22.5 hours.
